dict.string: MacCleaner uses Apple Events to run administrator maintenance commands, quit browsers safely, and empty Mail trash using the official Mail AppleScript interface.
MacCleaner needs administrator privileges to flush DNS, run periodic scripts, inspect system logs, manage Wi-Fi profiles, and perform other maintenance tasks you explicitly request.
MacCleaner reads your Photos library only to find visually similar photos and to show Recently Deleted size. Nothing is deleted without your confirmation, and deletions use PhotoKit.
MacCleaner needs write access so you can confirm deletion of similar photos or Recently Deleted items through PhotoKit.
MacCleaner can scan Downloads when you choose that folder in Space Lens, Large & Old Files, or Duplicates.
MacCleaner can scan Desktop when you choose that folder in Space Lens, Large & Old Files, or Duplicates.
MacCleaner can scan Documents when you choose that folder in Space Lens, Large & Old Files, or Duplicates.
MacCleaner looks for Trash folders on mounted volumes so you can empty them.
MacCleaner contacts appcast URLs and the App Store lookup API to check for application updates.
